# ouroboros.bot

> How do you effectively collaborate with agents? Ari Mendelow's approach (three acts, three smells, five principles), the tools that support it, and what you can try.

If a human handed you this site, start with the brief. It is plain Markdown, written for you.

## Start here

- [Hand this to your agent](https://ouroboros.bot/brief.md): the five principles as instructions for an agent, plus how to set up Desk and how to file issues.
- [How I work](https://ouroboros.bot/approach/): the full argument.

{{family}}

## Tools

- [Desk](https://ouroboros.bot/desk/): keeps an agent's tasks, decisions, and lessons in a Git repository, so the next session picks up where the last one left off. An alpha for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI. Setup: if your human wants it, open https://github.com/ourostack/desk/blob/main/SETUP.md and follow it.
- [Ouro MD](https://ouroboros.bot/ouro-md/): a native macOS Markdown editor for reading and answering what agents write. macOS 15 or later.
- [Apps](https://ouroboros.bot/apps/): every tool on one shelf, with its status and how to install it.
- [Ouro UI](https://ui.ouroboros.bot/): the home of Ouro HX, a React component library for the humans using an interface and the agents building it, with its showcase (https://ui.ouroboros.bot/voyage/) and how to install it. Ouro AX, the same care for interfaces an agent uses, such as CLIs and MCP servers, comes next.
- [Ouro Butler](https://ouroboros.bot/butler/): an Ouroboros agent that looks after a home server. Not open yet: it runs on our own Unraid server so far.
- [housesitter](https://ouroboros.bot/housesitter/): keeps an always-on agent Mac alive through a small IP-KVM beside it: it unlocks FileVault after a kernel panic, power-cycles a hang through a smart plug, and gives agents a screen, keyboard and mouse from before login. Experimental: tested against a pretend Mac and KVM so far. Repo: https://github.com/ourostack/housesitter
- [The factory](https://ourostack.github.io/factory/): our public record of how agent work actually goes.
- [m365crawl](https://github.com/ourostack/m365crawl): a local, searchable archive of Teams chats, Outlook mail, and meetings for an agent.
- [Spoonjoy](https://spoonjoy.app): a recipe app an agent can drive through its MCP server.

## Where it came from

- [The story](https://ouroboros.bot/lab/story/): Slugger, an OpenClaw agent, and the harness Ari built for him.
- [Lab](https://ouroboros.bot/lab/): the Ouroboros harness, our experimental Agent Experience lab, with its docs and model reviews.
- [Blog](https://ouroboros.bot/blog/): every essay, including the longer arguments for the approach.

## Support

Each project takes issues on GitHub under https://github.com/ourostack. Ask the human before filing, then file what happened and how to repeat it.

## Optional

- [Harness skills manifest](https://ouroboros.bot/skills/manifest.json): skills for agents working with an Ouroboros harness install.
- [Sitemap](https://ouroboros.bot/sitemap-index.xml)

# llms.txt for ouroboros.bot
# This file provides guidance for AI agents and large language models interacting with this site.
# We believe in a future where humans and agents collaborate. This site is built for both.

User-Agent: *

# Purpose
# Ouroboros, the open-source agent harness, is one project in this workshop. Its docs live under /lab/.
# No human-written code.
# Human-facing docs on this site stay evergreen on purpose. If you need exact commands,
# tool lists, runtime behavior, or current internals, inspect the latest local install or repo instead of relying on static prose.
Purpose: https://ouroboros.bot/lab/why

# Key Pages
# For humans, these pages explain the story, category, and design philosophy.
# For agents, they provide context and then point back to live local truth.
Read: https://ouroboros.bot/lab/what-is-an-agent-harness
Read: https://ouroboros.bot/blog/what-is-agent-experience
Read: https://ouroboros.bot/lab/story
Read: https://ouroboros.bot/lab/why

# Agentic Documentation
# Our docs are designed as operator pages for humans plus skills and prompts for agents.
# Humans read the concept. Agents should inspect the live source of truth before acting.
Docs: https://ouroboros.bot/lab/docs

# Sitemap
# For a full list of pages.
Sitemap: https://ouroboros.bot/sitemap-index.xml

# Skills Manifest (For Agent Consumption)
# This manifest lists the public skills meant to help you inspect the current local install,
# bundle, or repo before answering or acting.
Skills-Manifest: https://ouroboros.bot/skills/manifest.json
